purpose: Review official Xuancheng cadastral/registration custody and public geographic-information channels for safe anonymous parcel geometry and stable parcel identity.
assessment: Xuancheng Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and its municipal Real Estate Registration Center are evidenced local registry/cadastral custodians. The bureau's 2025 notice documents a public Xuancheng Tianditu natural-resource platform with thematic layers, but no current safe anonymous parcel vector response, native identity, CRS or geometry was qualified.
registryAssessment: The official Real Estate Registration Center page assigns city-district unified registration, query-service, data-archive and basic-information-platform functions. The official Tianditu notice describes public thematic geospatial information, not an open parcel layer.
